evidence.mission_note: This conflicts with the current need for a manual, rain-capable, budget-band daily. At best it is a speculative future keeper competing for cash the RF or Z3 search should use.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 1983 US-market Ur-Quattro VIN, a clean PA title, a linked Carfax, a 5-speed manual and about 43.5k claimed miles. It also describes dated service work from 2021 to 2026, including timing belt, fuel and vacuum hoses, brake lines and a November 2026 brake master cylinder. Observed problems are disclosed by the seller: paint bubbles on the hood and passenger fender, corrosion on the fuel tank top and underbody, aged clutch hoses, a dead window switch, and tires dated 2012 and 2019. The seller also warns the Milltek-exhausted car may not pass emissions, which matters directly for California smog on a 1983 car. Strut tower and floor condition, compression, diff-lock function and the hydraulic accumulator remain unverified; the gallery evidence said to address some of these was not captured here. The auction is a reserve auction closing within about an hour, so no buyer-side PPI can occur before a binding bid. The single comp, a $60k BaT sale, reflects a less-flawed car than this one.
evidence.next_action: Before bidding, ask the seller in comments whether the Milltek exhaust retains a catalytic converter, and request strut-tower and floor lift photos.
